name: Sakura Maid 2
source: Sakura Maid follows the story of Sena, the only maid working in her Master’s manor. In between strange plants, unusual guests visiting the manor and the ever looming menace of dust, Sena has a lot of work to do. But she happily does all of her for her Master, eagerly waiting for when she will return home.
translation: 《樱花女仆》讲述了濑名的故事，濑名是主人庄园里唯一的女仆。在奇怪的植物、拜访庄园的不寻常客人和不断迫近的灰尘威胁之间，塞纳有很多工作要做。但她却很高兴地为她的师父做了一切，热切地等待着她回家的时间。
